verdict.rationale: Meltano's plugin model treats loaders as a distinct plugin type in project config (meltano-docs-17, meltano-docs-29). It advertises 600+ connectors and moving data 'from any source to any destination' (meltano-docs-4, meltano-docs-5), which implies you can swap destinations while keeping pipelines run via `meltano run` (meltano-docs-37). However, the evidence never names loaders for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or Postgres, and object storage appears only in a container-image sizing note (meltano-docs-32). Missing for 10: explicit documented loaders for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and Postgres; evidence of object-storage/lake loading; documentation showing that switching loaders needs no pipeline changes; independent or hands-on corroboration.
